content.short: BlockSec provides full-stack blockchain security services, including code audits and attack monitoring and blocking.
content.description: BlockSec is a full-stack Web3 security service provider committed to strengthening security and usability across the evolving Web3 landscape to support broad adoption. Its offerings include smart contract and EVM-chain security auditing, the Phalcon platform for ongoing security monitoring and attack blocking, the MetaSleuth platform for fund tracking and investigation, and the MetaSuites extension to help Web3 builders operate more efficiently in the crypto world.
content.meta: BlockSec is a full-stack Web3 security service provider. Discover BlockSec and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
